stakeholders.name: platform_operator
stakeholders.situation: Writes and enforces the distribution terms; collects the margin.

stakeholders.name: publisher_consortium
stakeholders.situation: Institutional counter-party paying the margin; same power atom, opposite side.

stakeholders.name: independent_creators
stakeholders.situation: Bears the terms with no negotiating position.

six_questions.coordination_function: A common distribution rail is genuinely useful.
six_questions.transfer_function: Margin moves from publishers and creators to the operator.
six_questions.disappearance_rationale: Distribution contracts would be renegotiated economy-wide.
six_questions.founding_problem: Fragmented distribution needed a common rail.
six_questions.founding_problem_corroboration: Industry analyses outside the operator attest the founding problem.
